title: Zoom Recognizer Options
description: Zoom Scribe (Live mode) STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'zoom'. Zoom segments turns server-side (silence-based) and returns one final transcript per speech turn; in the agent verb each one ends the user's turn: there are no interim results and no confidence scores (transcripts are reported with confidence 1.0). Supported languages: en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES, it-IT, fr-FR, de-DE, ar-SA, ar-AE, pt-BR, pt-PT.

apiKey.description: Zoom Build platform API key (or JWT). Overrides the key configured in jambonz.

turn_detection.description: Tunes Zoom's server-side turn detection, which is silence-based: a turn ends after silence_duration_ms of silence, whether or not the sentence is complete. Out-of-range values make Zoom end the session, so they are bounded here.

threshold.description: Speech detection threshold. Higher values need louder or clearer speech to start a turn.

prefix_padding_ms.description: Milliseconds of audio before detected speech to include in the turn.

silence_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds of silence that end a turn. Zoom's default is about 350; raise it so a mid-sentence pause does not split the turn.

zoomSttUri.description: Custom host to connect to instead of api.zoom.us (e.g. a proxy).

zoomSttUseTls.description: Use TLS when connecting to a custom host. Default true.
